products.name: ROVE RUKH (رخ)
products.inspiredBy: Signature Haute Creation • Amber, White Florals & Iris
products.shortDesc: The pinnacle of masculine refinement. Golden liquid in crystalline glass with Italian Bergamot, White Florals, and Smoked Amber.
products.description: ROVE RUKH (رخ) is our flagship creation. Encased in heavyweight crystalline glass with polished 24K gold accents, RUKH opens with zesty Italian bergamot and spicy cardamom, blooming into opulent Tuscan iris and white jasmine, before settling onto a majestic base of smoked golden amber, vetiver, and royal sandalwood. Over 16 hours of magnetic longevity.
products.heartNotes: Tuscan Iris, White Jasmine, Pink Peppercorn
products.baseNotes: Smoked Amber, Royal Sandalwood, Cashmere Wood, Vetiver

products.name: ROVE RAAZ (راز)
products.inspiredBy: Sensual Black Gold Mystery • White Florals, Cashmere & Dark Vanilla
products.shortDesc: An enigmatic feminine elixir. White blossom petals and warm golden nectar wrapped in velvet black marble mystery.
products.description: ROVE RAAZ (راز) captures the untamed secret of supreme elegance. Enveloped in mysterious dark gold aesthetics, this Eau De Parfum unfolds with luminous solar florals and delicate white petals, cascading into a deep sensual core of roasted tonka, creamy cashmere wood, and dark royal vanilla. Pure magnetic charm.
products.topNotes: White Blossoms, Golden Mandarin, Dewy Freesia
products.heartNotes: Velvet Jasmine, Cashmere Orchid, Soft Almond
products.baseNotes: Dark Madagascar Vanilla, Rich Amber, Golden Sandalwood

products.name: ROVE AFSANA (افسانہ)
products.inspiredBy: Romantic Golden Sunset • Sweet Peaches, Pink Berries & Rose Petals
products.shortDesc: A tale of unforgettable romance. Sun-ripened golden peaches, wild berries, and fresh pink roses bathed in golden hour light.
products.description: ROVE AFSANA (افسانہ) tells a poetic love story in scent. Bursting with succulent sun-kissed peaches and sweet ruby berries at the golden hour, dancing with exquisite Damask rose petals, and drying down to warm amber spun sugar and white musk. Soft, irresistible, and endlessly captivating.
products.topNotes: Sun-Kissed Peach, Wild Forest Berries, Bergamot
products.heartNotes: Damask Pink Rose, Solar Magnolia, Peony Petals
products.baseNotes: Spun Amber Sugar, White Musk, Soft Cedarwood

products.name: ROVE NAZ (ناز)
products.inspiredBy: Celestial White Floral Silk • Magnolia, Bergamot & Cashmere Musk
products.shortDesc: Ethereal purity and feminine pride. Sparkling magnolia, crisp white flowers, and soft velvet silk musk.
products.description: ROVE NAZ (ناز) is an ode to pure grace. Delicate crisp citrus opening leads into an ethereal bouquet of royal white gardenia, soft jasmine petals, and cashmere woods that embrace you like pure cashmere.

reviews.author: Bilal Ahmed
reviews.title: Bhai kya scent hai! 14 ghante pakka chal raha hai
reviews.comment: Elyscents se bhi pehle try kiya tha, but ROVE Imperial Oud projection is on another level. Kapron par agle din tak smell rehti hai. Packing is 10/10 luxury black gold box. 100% recommended!

reviews.author: Mahnoor Malik
reviews.title: Exact Baccarat Rouge vibe, so many compliments!
reviews.comment: I am so in love with Velvet Rouge 540! Office mein sab poch rahe hain konsa perfume lagaya hai. Sweet saffron and airy ambergris. Will definitely order full bottles again.

reviews.author: Shahzaib Butt
reviews.title: Sauvage Elixir ka perfect alternate
reviews.comment: Delivery Karachi mein 2 din mein mil gayi through COD. Packaging bhot solid hai bottle leak nahi hui. Fragrance projection is beast mode.

reviews.author: Komal Rizvi
reviews.title: Fresh floral and gardenia notes are gorgeous
reviews.comment: Very feminine, soft gardenia and subtle sweetness. Delivery was fast and cash on delivery was super smooth. Thank you ROVE Scents!

reviews.author: Hamza Tariq
reviews.title: ROVE RAAZ is an absolute mystery in a bottle
reviews.comment: The dark black marble aesthetic matched the smell completely. White blossom opening and then rich warm amber with dark vanilla. My wife loved it immediately. Pure luxury!

reviews.author: Ayesha Siddiqui
reviews.title: Sun-kissed peach & damask rose perfection
reviews.comment: AFSANA smells like a dream. Soft, fruity, and romantic without being overly sweet. Got compliments the first day I wore it to a wedding. 15 hours easily lasting.

reviews.author: Danial Qureshi
reviews.title: ROVE RUKH is the king of masculine fragrances
reviews.comment: Italian bergamot, iris and smoked amber create such an imperial masculine scent. Heavyweight crystal glass bottle feels like a 50,000 rupee perfume. Worth every single rupee.

reviews.author: Fatima Zahra
reviews.title: White floral silk note is heavenly
reviews.comment: Pure grace and elegant sillage. Does not cause headaches at all like local synthetic perfumes. You can smell the French oil concentration from the first spray.

reviews.author: Saad Babar
reviews.title: COD delivery within 2 days, outstanding service
reviews.comment: Ordered COD to Sialkot and received my package securely wrapped in bubblewrap with zero damage. Fragrance longevity exceeded my expectations.

reviews.author: Mariam Jamil
reviews.title: Best perfume investment in Pakistan!
reviews.comment: I was hesitant before ordering from Instagram ads, but ROVE Scents is 100% genuine quality. The saffron and amber trail stays on clothes even after wash.
